# W2-141 (DAEO-xwro) — the independent test designer's return

- **task:** W2-141 acceptance tests (DAEO-xwro): the guard refuses an engineer's Grep, Glob or recursive Bash search
  that can reach its own acceptance folder unless the call excludes it, saying how (DEC-1093 (2)); profile STANDARD.
- **status:** DONE (with one decision package, P-1, below).
- **work_completed:** read the ticket, `EMG-common.md`, `src/gov/guard/reads.py`, `decide.py` (decide and the read
  branch), `role_paths.py`, `protected.py` (`_shell_search`), `tests/unit/guard/test_reads.py`, the W2-84 and W2-133
  acceptance folders, guard4_check.py's G-14 cases, the path map's `role_paths:` block, and `gov accept`'s map
  reader. Probed today's decide on a planted project; ran the planted grep and find commands for real to check which
  reach the folder and which exclusion forms keep it out. Wrote 88 cases in `tests/acceptance/W2-141/` with a README
  map and the interface the engineer builds to.
- **files_changed:** `tests/acceptance/W2-141/` only: `README.md`, `conftest.py`, `w2_141_support.py`,
  `test_w2_141_grep_glob.py` (S1), `test_w2_141_bash.py` (S2), `test_w2_141_unchanged.py` (S3, failure lines).
  Commit `c3e0e16bc5ee` on `w2/W2-141-tests` (trailers Task DAEO-xwro, Implements DEC-1093 DEC-1097, Role
  independent-test-designer).
- **evidence:** sandbox check: Bash runs in the launch sandbox (writes only this worktree and its TMPDIR; no rg, ag or
  ack installed; GNU grep 3.11). `ps` check: nothing of mine running at the end (one pid namespace per call; only the
  `ps` itself). pytest through `heavy_slot.sh`, `PYTHONPATH=<this worktree>/src`: 88 tests, 50 failed, 38 passed
  (0.55 s). `gov accept W2-141 --root <this worktree>` (heavy slot): exit 3; success-1 4 passed 22 failed, success-2 0
  and 28, success-3 30 and 0, failure-1 5 and 34, failure-2 0 and 34, failure-3 33 and 0; unmapped 0; totals 38 and
  50. TMPDIR: 1.3M, 318 inodes.
- **tests:** the case list (node ids under `tests/acceptance/W2-141/`; each row covers all parameters):
  - S1 `test_w2_141_grep_glob.py::test_s1_a_call_reaching_the_own_acceptance_folder_is_refused_saying_how` — red
    (13): 8 Grep calls refused today with `TESTS_REFUSAL` (names neither the folder nor the glob); 5 Glob calls with
    `**` allowed today.
  - S1 `::test_s1_the_same_when_the_ticket_is_named_by_its_wbs_id` — red (2), same reasons, GOV_TICKET as WBS id.
  - S1 `::test_s1_the_same_for_an_engineer_subagent_of_an_orchestrator_session` — red (2), same reasons.
  - S1 `::test_s1_the_grep_call_with_the_exclusion_is_allowed` — red (4): Grep with `!tests/acceptance/<WBS>/**` is
    refused today (a negated glob keeps nothing out in `_Judge.above`).
  - S1 `::test_s1_the_exclusion_is_taken_when_the_ticket_is_named_by_its_wbs_id` — red, same.
  - S1 `::test_s1_guard_a_glob_call_that_cannot_reach_the_folder_is_allowed` — green guard (3).
  - S1 `::test_s1_guard_the_exclusion_does_not_open_a_call_aimed_inside_the_folder` — green guard.
  - S2 `test_w2_141_bash.py::test_s2_a_recursive_search_reaching_the_own_acceptance_folder_is_refused_saying_how` —
    red (21): 17 grep -r / rg / find forms refused today without the folder or a form; ag and ack (4) allowed today.
  - S2 `::test_s2_the_search_with_the_exclusion_is_allowed` — red (6): grep `--exclude-dir=<WBS>`, rg `-g '!…'`, find
    `-prune` / `-not -path` (also piped into xargs grep) refused today.
  - S2 `::test_s2_the_same_when_the_ticket_is_named_by_its_wbs_id` — red.
  - S3 `test_w2_141_unchanged.py::test_s3_guard_an_engineer_search_that_cannot_reach_its_folder_is_allowed` — green
    guard (19), incl. G-14's grep by pattern only and a names-only `find . -name '*.py'`.
  - S3 `::test_s3_guard_other_roles_are_unaffected` — green guard (6 roles: orchestrator, independent-auditor as
    reviewer, independent-test-designer, product-spec, ticket-lead, research).
  - S3 `::test_s3_guard_another_ticket_s_engineer_reads_this_ticket_s_tests` — green guard.
  - S3 `::test_s3_guard_g14_cases_answer_as_before` — green guard (G-14 cases 1, 3, 4, 5 through decide).

  Every red fails on the line it names, none on a premise (checked from the junit report).
- **discoveries:**
  - D-1: GNU grep's `--exclude-dir` matches a folder's base name when recursing. `--exclude-dir=tests/acceptance/W2-941`
    (and `./tests/...`) keeps nothing out (run for real on the planted project, grep 3.11); only `--exclude-dir=W2-941`
    does. `EMG-common.md`'s line "`grep -r --exclude-dir=<that folder>`" and the briefs' exclusion line, read as a path,
    fail open. The tests refuse the path form and take the base-name form; the grep refusal must name
    `--exclude-dir=<WBS>`.
  - D-2: on integrate the decide function already refuses an engineer's broad Grep and grep -r / rg / find -exec (W2-58's
    search-from-above rule); its gaps are Glob with `**` (names only), ag and ack, no exclusion taken, and no folder or
    advice in the reason. The gap W2-138 met is in the live guard: `.claude/hooks/role_reads.py` lets "a search from a
    folder above" through (its module note, line 7; path map lines 538-540). That hook is not in W2-141's allowed
    paths, and these tests drive decide only, as the ticket says.
  - D-3: `reads.py`'s module note says no message carries a path; S1 asks the refusal to name the folder. The tests ask
    only for the project-relative folder from the ticket's WBS id.
  - D-4: the Glob tool has no exclusion field: a Glob call can keep the folder out only by its path or pattern; the
    tests ask its refusal to say so (the reason holds `path` or `pattern`).
- **risks:** rg, ag and ack were not run for real (not installed): rg's `-g` exclusion is tested only from the root
  with no path. A search whose own folder is absent or empty is not tested either way (README N-1). One Grep glob per
  call (N-4).
- **lessons:** the guard refused a `sed -i` on the README as "names given at run time" (it read the `\|` in the
  replacement as a pipe into xargs): a false refusal, worked round with the Edit tool (DEC-1040 item 3).
- **proposed_decisions:** P-1 (decision package, for the CTO): correct the exclusion line in `EMG-common.md` and the
  engineer briefs from `grep -r --exclude-dir=<that folder>` to `grep -r --exclude-dir=<WBS id>` (GNU grep honours the
  base name only). Options: (a) correct now, a one-line edit of the brief files; (b) leave it until W2-141 lands (the
  guard then refuses the path form, saying the right one); (c) keep it and have the guard take the path form as an
  exclusion (fails open: grep still reads the folder). Recommendation (a); confidence high (run for real).
- **unresolved:** guard4_check.py itself was not run: it runs the main tree's live hook under the pinned interpreter,
  the CTO's check after the re-pin (S3). G-14's second case (a case revised for the ticket in another ticket's folder)
  is the role_reads hook's, not reproduced through decide (README N-3).
- **recommended_next_action:** start the engineer on DAEO-xwro against `tests/acceptance/W2-141/` at `c3e0e16bc5ee`,
  building to the README's interface; settle P-1.

TESTS-READY: `tests/acceptance/W2-141/` at `c3e0e16bc5ee` on `w2/W2-141-tests`: 88 cases, 50 red (S1 22, S2 28), 38
green guards (S1 4, S3 34). The refusal's wording (the folder and one exclusion form per tool) and the allowed
exclusion forms are in the tests' README; grep's exclusion is the base-name form `--exclude-dir=<WBS>` (D-1).

No line of this ticket's implementation was seen: every search stayed inside this worktree, the main tree's tools
folder and the role_reads hook of this worktree.
